meta.name: get-available-resources
meta.description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检测主机资源限制并输出JSON快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要了解本地机器资源限制后再运行任务
copy.tagline_en: Detect host resource limits and output JSON snapshot
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to know your local machine's resource limits before running tasks

howto.what: 当开始计算密集型任务（如大数据分析、模型训练、并行处理）时，Claude 自动检测系统 CPU、GPU、内存、磁盘等资源，生成 JSON 文件并提供优化建议（如并行 worker 数、GPU 加速、内存策略等）。
howto.when: 用户提出资源密集型任务（如处理大文件、训练模型、并行计算）或明确询问系统资源时触发。

say.text: 我要分析一个 50GB 的基因组数据集，先检查资源。
say.note: 触发资源检测并给出建议

say.text: 训练神经网络，看看有没有 GPU 可用。
say.note: 检测 GPU 并推荐后端

say.text: 处理 10000 个文件，推荐最优并行度。

howto.what_en: When a user starts a compute-intensive task (e.g., big data analysis, model training, parallel processing), Claude automatically detects system resources (CPU, GPU, memory, disk) and generates a JSON file with optimization recommendations (e.g., parallel workers, GPU acceleration, memory strategy).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions a resource-intensive task (e.g., process large files, train a model, parallel computing) or explicitly asks about system resources.

say_en.text: I need to analyze a 50GB genomics dataset. Check resources first.
Train a neural network. Detect available GPUs.
